name: Adam Telle
current_role: Acting Secretary of the Army (since September 2026); Assistant Secretary of the Army for Civil Works
summary: Adam Telle, the Army’s assistant secretary for civil works (overseeing the Corps of Engineers), became acting Army secretary in September 2026 after Dan Driscoll resigned following clashes with Pete Hegseth.
